r3.why: 12 or 13 zodiac constellations straddling the ecliptic, uncertain origin, c.400 BC Babylonian/Chaldean, northern and southern lists: 10,11,41,42.

r4.why: Asterisms not formal constellations but used to navigate, within or across constellations, teapot and Big Dipper examples: 20-22.
